title: 拖延与提前完成 PPTS
author: Waqar Husain, Khaled Trabelsi, Achraf Ammar, Zahra Saif & Haitham Jahrami
notice: 中文为依照正式论文英文题目所作的未验证翻译。4399 描述性均分，非原量表标准分；不作诊断，不设临床阈值或常模。原研究对象为18–38岁成年人；小机作答仅作娱乐演绎，不具有人类量表效度。
instruction: 请选择每种行为在你身上出现的频率。原文仅命名量尺两端，中间档位保留数字。

items.text: 即使知道不该这样，我还是会拖延开始重要任务。
items.original: I delay getting started on important tasks, even when I know I shouldn't.

items.text: 我总是推迟处理令人不快的杂事或义务。
items.original: I keep putting off unpleasant chores or obligations.

items.text: 我发现自己会漫无目的地浏览，而不是做正事。
items.original: I find myself aimlessly browsing instead of working.

items.text: 我会等到最后一刻才为考试或截止日期做准备。
items.original: I wait until the last minute to prepare for tests or deadlines.

items.text: 我告诉自己“明天”能完成更多，而不是今天就付诸行动。
items.original: I tell myself I'll get more done "tomorrow" rather than following through today.

items.text: 我把时间浪费在不重要的干扰上，而不是优先事项上。
items.original: I waste time on unimportant distractions instead of priorities.

items.text: 我会拖延运动、饮食或预约等与健康有关的事情。
items.original: I procrastinate on health habits like exercise, diet, or appointments.

items.text: 即使是小决定，我也会不必要地拖着不做。
items.original: I unnecessarily delay making even small decisions.

items.text: 我会太久不回复电子邮件、消息或电话。
items.original: I leave emails, messages or calls unanswered for too long.

items.text: 由于拖延清洁或整理，我的空间变得杂乱无章。
items.original: My spaces become cluttered and disorganized from postponing cleaning/organizing.

items.text: 我会尽快完成任务，好把它们处理掉。
items.original: I complete tasks as soon as possible to get them out of the way.

items.text: 我会立刻处理杂事或义务，而不是拖延。
items.original: I take care of chores or obligations immediately rather than delaying.

items.text: 我会马上处理令人不快的任务，不把它们往后拖。
items.original: I tackle unpleasant tasks right away without postponing.

items.text: 在可能的情况下，我会努力提前完成事情。
items.original: I try to get things done ahead of schedule when possible.

items.text: 即使是小事，我也不会拖着不做决定。
items.original: I don't postpone making decisions, even on small matters.

items.text: 我会及时回复消息、电子邮件或电话，不加拖延。
items.original: I reply to messages, emails, or calls promptly without delay.

items.text: 我始终保持工作和生活空间整洁有序。
items.original: I keep my work and living spaces consistently neat and organized.

items.text: 我不会等到截止日期才开始重要任务或目标。
items.original: I don't wait for deadlines to start on important tasks or goals.

scoring_note: 4399 描述性均分，非原量表标准分：拖延10题、提前完成8题分别取算术均分，范围均为1–5；无反向题，不合并总分，不把提前完成倒分为拖延。分数仅描述对应行为的报告频率，不能据此判定健康与否。
source_version: Husain et al. (2025), original 18-item PPTS; Proc1–10 and Prec1/2/3/5/6/7/8/9

sources.evidence: Measures: 18 items, 1 Never to 5 Always; Rights and permissions: CC BY 4.0.
Initial 20 item wordings; remove Prec4 and Prec10, retain the original source IDs.

scoring_caveat: 未核得原作者个人合成评分公式。均分是4399为自我了解设置的描述性汇总，不声称复现论文所报告的子量表总分。
